generic_domain.justification: The optimization domain is the broadest as it covers both convex and non-convex optimization. Convex optimization, a subset of optimization, deals with problems where the set of feasible points forms a convex set and the objective function is convex. Non-convex optimization is another subset, dealing with more complex problems where the function may have multiple local optima. Optimization as a whole encompasses all types of optimization techniques, making it the most generic domain.
